description_en: Queries the alert statistics of container assets
description_zh: 查询容器资产的告警统计数据
name: DescribeContainerStatistics

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the container cluster to query.
You can call the [DescribeGroupedContainerInstances](~~DescribeGroupedContainerInstances~~) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询的容器集群的ID。
您可以调用[DescribeGroupedContainerInstances](~~DescribeGroupedContainerInstances~~)接口获取该参数
parameters.name: cluster_id

Data.description_en: The detailed alert statistics of container assets
Data.description_zh: 容器资产告警的详细统计数据

RemindAlarmCount.description_en: The number of alerts with the Reminder risk level
RemindAlarmCount.description_zh: 风险级别为提醒的告警个数

SeriousAlarmCount.description_en: The number of alerts with the Urgent risk level
SeriousAlarmCount.description_zh: 风险级别为紧急的告警个数

SuspiciousAlarmCount.description_en: The number of alerts with the Suspicious risk level
SuspiciousAlarmCount.description_zh: 风险级别为可疑的告警个数

TotalAlarmCount.description_en: The total number of security alerts in the container cluster
TotalAlarmCount.description_zh: 当前容器集群的安全告警总数

TotalNode.description_en: The total number of nodes in the container cluster
TotalNode.description_zh: 当前容器集群总节点个数

hasRiskNode.description_en: The number of nodes that have alerts in the container cluster
hasRiskNode.description_zh: 当前容器集群中存在告警的节点个数

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. Alibaba Cloud generates a unique identifier for each request, which can be used for troubleshooting and diagnostics
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
